data.summary: All figures match Apple's reported FY2024 results as best I recall them: revenue $391.0B (+2.0%), gross profit $180.7B (46.2% margin), operating income $123.2B (31.5% margin), R&D $31.4B, net income $93.7B (-3.4%) and diluted EPS $6.08 vs $6.13. Not checked against source documents. Net income fell because of a one-time tax charge of about $10.2B from the EU State Aid ruling. The analysis doesn't say this, but no statement is wrong.
